approach: The game's x86 code recompiled to C; native kernel replacement; graphics, sound and USB chips still simulated, drawn with Vulkan
notes: Early. Missions A-1, A-2 and B-1 played by hand, not yet played to the end. Adds widescreen, higher resolution and a settings page in the game's own OPTIONS screen; any controller works, plugged in at any time. Run so far on an NVIDIA RTX 4070 and a Radeon 890M. Needs your own copy of the game.
